author: Shelved as a maybe (the user, 2026-10-17: 'I may be going into scope creep territory'): Gear, held items as a creature's second ability. Not loaded by Cards > Generate Faction Decks; the rules (Equip, Hover, Self-Repair) stay in the code, so bringing one back is moving it into its subfaction's file.

cards.name: Smartwatch
cards.flavor: Tracks your steps, your sleep, your heart rate and your productivity. Reports three of them to HR.
cards.notes: Gear (Pokémon's Life Orb): Recoil while it stays in play, +2 damage on its attacks and 1 damage to itself after each. A megacorp's subscription device, the hustle strapped to a wrist. Corporate.
cards.picture: A sleek smartwatch on a sweating wrist, its screen flashing 'Stand up! Productivity -3%', a subscription renewal notice sliding in underneath.

cards.name: Exoskeleton
cards.flavor: Standard issue. Batteries not included. Batteries never included.
cards.notes: Gear (Pokémon's Assault Vest): Unbothered while it stays in play, enemy effects can't lower its stats. On top of the creature's own ability. Statecraft.
cards.picture: A soldier in a powered military exoskeleton standing guard at a checkpoint, an extension cord trailing from his back to a wall socket in the guard booth.

cards.name: Q Branch
cards.notes: Gear: Insider Job while it stays in play, its damage ignores Armor. The quartermaster's gadgets, for the faction of glass cannons that meets walls. Shadow Ops.
cards.picture: An old quartermaster in a lab coat demonstrating an exploding briefcase to a bored agent, a test dummy in the background missing its head.

cards.name: Hovercraft
cards.flavor: Floats over the problem. Never solves it.
cards.notes: Gear (Pokémon's Heavy-Duty Boots): Hover while it stays in play, Slot Effects don't touch it (no Landmine, Barbed Snare or Checkpoint as it enters or leaves). Tech.
cards.picture: A sleek hovercraft gliding over a minefield, every mine underneath it blinking red and doing nothing, a deminer watching with his mouth open.

cards.name: Nanobots
cards.flavor: Billions of tiny repairmen. One tiny union.
cards.notes: Gear (Pokémon's Leftovers): Self-Repair while it stays in play, it heals 2 each Dawn. Utopia.
cards.picture: A swarm of glittering nanobots stitching a robot's torn arm back together, a few of them on a tiny picket line holding 'Fair Wages' signs.
